ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The attribution «Паркер» (Parker) is printed as a surname only, so 'Parker', not the website's 'Theodore Parker'; «отец твой небесный» (otets tvoy nebesny, 'your heavenly father') keeps the lowercase and adds no verb. «Непротивление злу насилием» (neprotivleniye zlu nasiliyem) is 'non-resistance to evil by violence', and «божественное начало» (bozhestvennoye nachalo) is 'the divine source'.
